settings.title: Advanced poly-side drainage ribs
settings.body: Deep horizontal ribs increase surface area for superior drainage — water and fine debris move through the grooves instead of smearing across the floor.

settings.title: Precision micro-grip surface
settings.body: A non-slip micro-grip texture between the ribs catches pet hair, dander, and grit on contact — wet or dry.

settings.title: Ultra-durable reinforced edge
settings.body: Reinforced edges stand up to skirting boards, doorways, and daily abuse without fraying like cloth pads.

settings.title: Fade-resistant hygienic colorant
settings.body: The signature purple is fade-resistant and easy to read as clean — you can see when the head needs a rinse.

settings.title: Fast-drying core
settings.body: A non-absorbent, fast-drying core helps the head rinse clean and dry ready for the next pass — less smell, less slime.

settings.heading: The mop head is the technology.
settings.lede: Nano Slide Technology ® is built into Slide XL’s special PVA mop head — a ridged, purple cleaning surface engineered to grab pet hair dry, wash floors wet, and release the mess when it hits water.
settings.image_1_alt: Purple Nano Slide PVA mop head with water droplets on white tile
settings.image_1_caption: Special PVA head on tile — drainage ribs hold and release water cleanly.
settings.image_2_alt: Purple Nano Slide PVA mop head with water droplets on black studio surface
settings.image_2_caption: Close-up of the ridged PVA surface — the heart of Nano Slide Technology ®.
settings.tech_heading: Special PVA, built for hair and hard floors
settings.tech_body: Unlike ordinary foam or microfibre, Slide XL’s purple PVA head uses Nano Slide Technology ® — a precision-ridged polymer surface that traps hair and dirt in the grooves, then lets go when rinsed. That is why one head can sweep, mop, and dry without turning into a sticky hair magnet.
